h1.en: Electric 50 Concrete Pump keeps its own figures; Semi-trailer truck is only the picture
h1.zh: 为什么电动50型混凝土泵的外形尺寸不是泵送距离保留自己的数字，「半掛式卡車」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Main-unit weight is is 2800 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动50型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。理论输送量是26 m³/h，最大出口压力是30 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck. The picture shows Semi-trailer truck. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Theoretical Output is 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. Main-unit weight is is 2800 kg. Subject: Caterpillar 315C L Excavator cleaning up tornado debris. Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck。画面是Semi-trailer truck。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动50型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。外形尺寸是4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 2800 kg. The frame “Excavator” shows Caterpillar 315C L Excavator cleaning up tornado debris and is not a site measurement of this model. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 理论输送量是26 m³/h，最大出口压力是30 MPa。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. The shown output stays 26 m³/h. Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m.
body.zh: 画面「Excavator」的主体是Caterpillar 315C L 挖掘机 cleaning up tornado debris，不是这个型号的工地实测。主体：Caterpillar 315C L 挖掘机 cleaning up tornado debris。

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 26 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-trailer_truck.
